http_request_duration_highr_seconds.description: Latency with many buckets but no API specific labels. Made for more accurate percentile calculations.

http_request_duration_seconds.description: Latency with only few buckets by handler. Made to be only used if aggregation by handler is important.

http_requests.description: Total number of requests by method, status and handler.

process_cpu_seconds.description: Total user and system CPU time spent in seconds.

process_max_fds.description: Maximum number of open file descriptors.

process_start_time_seconds.description: Start time of the process since unix epoch in seconds.

python_gc_collections.description: Number of times this generation was collected

vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds.description: Histogram of e2e request latency in seconds.

vllm:engine_sleep_state.description: Engine sleep state; awake = 0 means engine is sleeping; awake = 1 means engine is awake; weights_offloaded = 1 means sleep level 1; discard_all = 1 means sleep level 2.

vllm:estimated_flops_per_gpu.description: Estimated number of floating point operations per GPU (for Model Flops Utilization calculations).

vllm:estimated_read_bytes_per_gpu.description: Estimated number of bytes read from memory per GPU (for Model Flops Utilization calculations).

vllm:estimated_write_bytes_per_gpu.description: Estimated number of bytes written to memory per GPU (for Model Flops Utilization calculations).

vllm:external_prefix_cache_hits.description: External prefix cache hits from KV connector cross-instance cache sharing, in terms of number of cached tokens.

vllm:external_prefix_cache_queries.description: External prefix cache queries from KV connector cross-instance cache sharing, in terms of number of queried tokens.

vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds.description: Histogram of inter-token latency in seconds.

vllm:iteration_tokens_total.description: Histogram of number of tokens per engine_step.

vllm:kv_offload_cpu_allocation_size.description: Histogram of the number of CPU chunks requested by each KV offload prepare_store call.

vllm:kv_offload_cpu_cache_read_usage_per.description: Fraction of CPU KV-cache space currently pinned by in-flight loads that have not yet completed (0.0 = idle, 1.0 = saturated).

vllm:kv_offload_cpu_cache_usage_perc.description: Fraction of CPU KV-cache space currently pinned by active transfers (0.0 = idle, 1.0 = saturated). Sustained high values indicate transfers (stores or promotions) may be dropped due to insufficient capacity.

vllm:kv_offload_cpu_cache_write_usage_pe.description: Fraction of CPU KV-cache space currently pinned by in-flight stores that have not yet completed (0.0 = idle, 1.0 = saturated).

vllm:kv_offload_load_bytes.description: Total bytes loaded from offload storage to GPU.

vllm:kv_offload_load_size.description: Histogram of KV offload load operation size, in bytes.

vllm:kv_offload_load_time.description: Total load time from offload storage to GPU, in seconds.

vllm:kv_offload_lookup_async_delay_secon.description: Histogram of time between a request's offload lookup first deferring and the following lookup resolving, or request finish, in seconds.

vllm:kv_offload_lookup_sync_delay_second.description: Histogram of the time spent in a single offload lookup call, in seconds.

vllm:kv_offload_size.description: Histogram of KV offload transfer size, in bytes.

vllm:kv_offload_store_bytes.description: Total bytes stored from GPU to offload storage.

vllm:kv_offload_store_size.description: Histogram of KV offload store operation size, in bytes.

vllm:kv_offload_store_time.description: Total store time from GPU to offload storage, in seconds.

vllm:kv_offload_tiering_chunk_hits.description: Number of chunk lookup hits in a tier, labeled by tier.

vllm:kv_offload_tiering_chunk_queries.description: Number of chunk lookup queries sent to a tier, labeled by tier.

vllm:kv_offload_tiering_lookup_sync_dela.description: Histogram of blocking time spent in a per-chunk tier lookup that resolved as a hit or miss, labeled by tier, in seconds.

vllm:kv_offload_total_bytes.description: Number of bytes offloaded by KV connector

vllm:kv_offload_total_time.description: Total time measured by all KV offloading operations

vllm:mm_cache_hits.description: Multi-modal cache hits, in terms of number of cached items.

vllm:mm_cache_queries.description: Multi-modal cache queries, in terms of number of queried items.

vllm:nixl_bytes_transferred.description: Histogram of bytes transferred per NIXL KV Cache transfers.

vllm:nixl_num_descriptors.description: Histogram of number of descriptors per NIXL  KV Cache transfers.

vllm:nixl_num_failed_notifications.description: Number of failed NIXL KV Cache notifications.

vllm:nixl_num_failed_transfers.description: Number of failed NIXL KV Cache transfers.

vllm:nixl_num_kv_expired_reqs.description: Number of requests that had their KV expire. NOTE: This metric is tracked on the P instance.

vllm:nixl_post_time_seconds.description: Histogram of transfer post time for NIXL KV Cache transfers.

vllm:nixl_xfer_time_seconds.description: Histogram of transfer duration for NIXL KV Cache transfers.

vllm:num_preemptions.description: Cumulative number of preemption from the engine.

vllm:num_requests_running.description: Number of requests in model execution batches.

vllm:num_requests_waiting.description: Number of requests waiting to be processed.

vllm:num_requests_waiting_by_reason.description: Number of waiting requests by reason. Reason labels: 'capacity' = waiting for scheduling capacity; 'deferred' = deferred by transient constraints (LoRA budget, KV transfer, blocked status). Sum of all reasons equals vllm:num_requests_waiting.

vllm:prefix_cache_hits.description: Prefix cache hits, in terms of number of cached tokens.

vllm:prefix_cache_queries.description: Prefix cache queries, in terms of number of queried tokens.

vllm:prompt_tokens_by_source.description: Number of prompt tokens by source.

vllm:prompt_tokens_cached.description: Number of cached prompt tokens (local + external).

vllm:request_decode_time_seconds.description: Histogram of time spent in DECODE phase for request.

vllm:request_inference_time_seconds.description: Histogram of time spent in RUNNING phase for request.

vllm:request_max_num_generation_tokens.description: Histogram of maximum number of requested generation tokens.

vllm:request_num_preemptions.description: Histogram of the number of times a request was preempted.

vllm:request_params_max_tokens.description: Histogram of the max_tokens request parameter.

vllm:request_params_n.description: Histogram of the n request parameter.

vllm:request_prefill_kv_computed_tokens.description: Histogram of new KV tokens computed during prefill (excluding cached tokens).

vllm:request_prefill_time_seconds.description: Histogram of time spent in PREFILL phase for request.

vllm:request_queue_time_seconds.description: Histogram of time spent in WAITING phase for request.

vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds.description: Histogram of time to first token in seconds.

vllm:tool_call_parser_invocations.description: Total number of ToolParser invocations. Non-streaming increments once per choice; streaming increments once per delta.
